brand.title: Approvals, records and audit in one calm workspace
brand.text: Every decision is traceable, every permission is explicit and every change is on the record.
brand.f1Text: Multi-stage workflows with clear owners, due dates and a full trail.
brand.f2Text: Roles, groups and conditional policies decide what each person can see and do.
brand.f3Text: Sign-ins, changes and decisions are recorded and searchable.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
